positive_claim: NVIDIA reported fiscal fourth-quarter revenue of $39.331 billion, up 78% year over year, and GAAP diluted EPS of $0.89, up 82%.

prices.source: Yahoo Finance daily closes, NVDA and SPY, 2025-02-26 and 2025-02-27 (Close column)

evidence.title: NVIDIA earnings and revenue growth
evidence.text: Fiscal Q4 2025 revenue was $39.331 billion (+78% year on year). GAAP diluted EPS was $0.89 (+82% year on year).
evidence.source: NVIDIA earnings release via SEC EDGAR

evidence.title: NVIDIA gross margin and revenue guidance
evidence.text: GAAP gross margin was 73.0%, down from 74.6% the preceding quarter and 76.0% a year earlier. Next-quarter guidance was 70.6% GAAP gross margin and 71.0% non-GAAP gross margin, each with a 50 basis point range in either direction. Revenue guidance was $43.0 billion, plus or minus 2%.
evidence.source: NVIDIA earnings release via SEC EDGAR

evidence.title: NVIDIA Data Center results
evidence.text: Data Center revenue reached $35.6 billion, up 93% year over year. Management noted billions of dollars in Blackwell sales in its first quarter on the market.
evidence.source: NVIDIA earnings release via SEC EDGAR

evidence.title: Broader market decline on February 27
evidence.text: The S&P 500 fell 1.6%, the Nasdaq Composite fell 2.8%, and the Russell 2000 fell 1.6%. Associated Press reported concerns about possible tariffs and weakness across high-momentum AI shares.

evidence.title: US GDP second estimate
evidence.text: The BEA reported annualized US real GDP growth of 2.3% for Q4 2024, versus 3.1% in Q3. The Q4 estimate was the same as the previously published advance estimate.
